steps.npc: Don't distract me while I'm on duty! This mine has to be protected!

steps.player: What's going to attack a mine?

steps.npc: Goblins! They wander everywhere, attacking anyone they think is small enough to be an easy victim. We need more cannons to fight them off properly.

steps.text: If the player has not completed Dwarf Cannon:

steps.npc: A new cannon can cost 750,000 coins, and the ammo isn't easy to get, but they do up to 30 hitpoints of damage with each shot. When you've got an important mine like this one to protect, it's worth the expense.
You're welcome. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.

steps.text: If the player has completed Dwarf Cannon:

steps.player: Well, I've done my bit to help with that.

steps.npc: Yes, I heard. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.

steps.player: Alright, I'll leave you alone now.
